verdict.rationale: ClickUp documents an official Public REST API with personal-token and OAuth2 auth, and publishes a raw OpenAPI specification for each API version, so developers can generate clients. Nothing in the evidence shows first-party SDKs or client libraries, so building against one means codegen or hand-written wrappers. The probe also found no OpenAPI spec at the standard paths. Missing for 10: official language SDKs/client libraries, SDK documentation, an easily discoverable OpenAPI spec, independent corroboration of developer tooling.
